covered_sections: PDF 1–3, 10–15, 17–59: identity, navigation, spectroscopy and model/motivation background
PDF 60–83: beam and target table, coincidence cubes, calibrations, gamma correlation and shell-model inputs
PDF 84–142: 82Ge, 80Ge, 78Ge gamma spectra and competing level assignments
PDF 143–189: systematics, strengths and upper limits, shell model and rigid-rotor comparisons
PDF 190–210: run-specific contaminants, angular correlation appendix, bibliography
comparison_coverage: OSTI BNL-203652-2018-JAAM manuscript, PDF 3–8 and two archive pages; shares 78Ge Gammasphere evidence with the thesis. Comparison does not extend to 80,82Ge.
remaining: Keep 674.8-keV angular correlation gate and multipolarity assumptions separate. Code, event selection and covariance were not replayed.
The 1133/1134-keV branch has a 2 percent ceiling in prose and 1.1 percent in Table 5.1. 976 keV has beam contamination.
The external lifetime and single-branch/M1 assumptions govern reduced-strength conversion. The M1 contrast quoted for 76Ge must not be copied to 78Ge.
A tentative 80Ge 3+ assignment and a competing 4+ remain in the literature. Shell-model and DFR discrepancies do not identify a unique 78Ge shape.
